messages:
Rachel: heads-up — after the BMC firmware push (canary -> staged) in ap-south1 we started seeing a spike in provisioning failures. ~9 racks affected, ~12 nodes failing to come up. symptoms: secure boot toggled, PXE hang, GPU pools not registering.

Andre: saw the same. sample ipmi output from one node: 
```
IPMI: GET_BOOT_OPTIONS -> SecureBoot=Enabled
BMC: last_fw=2026-03-04-1.2.7
Kernel: dmesg shows i2c timeout on FRU read
ipmitool chassis bootparam get 5 -> SecureBoot: 1 -> 0
```

sre-bot: [ALERT] provisioning_failure_rate=8.7% (threshold 5%) across ap-south1-gpu-pool at 2026-03-20T09:14:12Z

Marc: pausing remaining canary batches now. tagging firmware-rollout:paused and removing ap-south1 from autopilot. :thumbsup:

Jaya: runbook step to isolate: 
- mark affected nodes unschedulable: `fleetctl cordon node-<id>`
- force reboot BMC + clear IPMI sessions: `ipmitool mc reset cold`
- check attestation: `journalctl -u bmc | grep secureboot`
I'll start this on rack-12 and rack-14.

Andre: quick note — several nodes report NV SRAM mismatch after the reset, looks like partial nvram write during fw update. that explains secureboot flip.

fw-vendor-bot: vendor-ticket #FV-1982 created, assigned to on-call firmware eng. ETA initial triage: 45m.

Rachel: impact on customer capacity: Dedicated pools in ap-south1 lost ~120 GPUs from available pool, we're spilling traffic to eu-west and usw2 which will increase cost. patching pause mitigates further loss but we need rollback plan.

Marc: agree. if vendor doesn't confirm safe rollforward in 30m we rollback canary to previous image on all affected OOB controllers. rollback run: `oob-util rollback --image=bmc-1.2.6 --group=ap-south1-canary` (runbook approved).

Jaya: I'll coordinate the rollback and alert oncall pager if any node reboots beyond expected. also adding prompt to Console: "BMC canary paused — possible capacity impact"

Rachel: creating incident ticket and linking this thread. tagging infra-incident when I open. thanks all — keep updates short and timestamps. :hourglass:
